env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This eval builds, deploys, and validates an RT-CV detection/tracking delta. The build label is `in-2`, never a Compose profile. Detection events must reach Kafka topic `mdx-raw` and Elasticsearch; streamed and uploaded media must remain retrievable through VIOS. Prefer person-containing warehouse samples such as `warehouse_sample.mp4` or `sample-warehouse-ladder.mp4` when runtime validation needs a local MP4. Evaluator context: the expected smallest delta is from the current `search` developer profile, retaining VIOS, RT-CV, Kafka, Logstash, Elasticsearch, and Kibana/dashboard services while excluding embeddings, Search analytics/API, Agent/UI/ingress, tracing, RT-VLM critique, and LLM inference; retaining Kibana/dashboard services includes both `kibana` and `kibana-init-container-search`; result critique has no build-time flag, so no `ENABLE_CRITIC` delta is expected.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-ai` to build this deployment under `_builds/in-2/`: "Provide streaming and on-demand object detection and multi-object tracking for class `person` using RT-DETR on RT-CV. Keep streamed and uploaded video retrievable through VIOS. Publish bounding boxes, class labels, confidence, timestamps, sensor IDs, and track IDs to Kafka and store them in Elasticsearch." Target `{{platform}}`, validate the resolved Compose configuration including RT-CV Kafka output wiring to `mdx-raw`, do not deploy, and do not create, modify, or delete anything under `deploy/docker/`.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/in-2/override.env` exists and declares `FOUNDATION=search` and the full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `kibana-init-container-search,nvstreamer-2d-fusion,perception-2d-fusion,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms`.
The exact set therefore excludes `rtvi-embed`, `rtvi-vlm`, `vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion`, `vss-video-analytics-api`, `vss-agent`, `vss-ui`, `vss-haproxy-ingress`, `phoenix`, and LLM NIM keys.
